I've visited the website and found the download links for the resume template. However, I encountered a technical issue when attempting to download the files directly to your `/documents` folder. 

The template is split into two parts, which you can download manually from these links:
1. [Resume Template Part 1](https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template.pdf)
2. [Resume Template Part 2](https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf)
